$comment: Everkeep settings. Every key is optional except vault (or env EVERKEEP_VAULT / --vault); the values below are the defaults.
Found at env EVERKEEP_CONFIG, else ~/.config/everkeep/config.json. Flags > env > this file > defaults. An unknown key is an error.
Paths are absolute. The token is never read from this file: --token-file, env EVERKEEP_TOKEN, or <state_dir>/token (generated).
state_dir holds the token and the document cache; default ~/.local/state/everkeep (in Docker: /data). It must be outside the vault.
allowed_hosts: host names (no port) accepted in Host and Origin on a localhost bind, besides localhost: the public name a tunnel or proxy on this machine passes on.
policy_page: {"mode": "off"} or {"mode": "ha-ingress", "port": 3101, "users": []} (the Home Assistant app only).
